SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.title, LEFT(p.content, 300) AS content, p.status, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.created_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname, CONCAT('/api/files/', af.uuid) AS user_avatar_url, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_like pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.id AND pl.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS liked FROM post p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN file_record af ON af.id = u.avatar_file_id
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.status, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.created_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname, CONCAT('/api/files/', af.uuid) AS user_avatar_url, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_like pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.id AND pl.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS liked FROM post p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN file_record af ON af.id = u.avatar_file_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
